mechanism.zh-CN: 不施加抗生素，仅观察营养限制下的种群增长。
mechanism.en: No antibiotic is applied; only population growth under nutrient limitation is observed.

mechanism.zh-CN: β-内酰胺类药物；干扰细胞壁合成。
mechanism.en: A beta-lactam antibiotic that interferes with cell-wall synthesis.

mechanism.zh-CN: 结合 30S 核糖体亚基并抑制蛋白质合成；通常被描述为抑菌性。
mechanism.en: Binds the 30S ribosomal subunit and inhibits protein synthesis; commonly described as bacteriostatic.

mechanism.zh-CN: 抑制 DNA gyrase（拓扑异构酶 II）和拓扑异构酶 IV。
mechanism.en: Inhibits DNA gyrase (topoisomerase II) and topoisomerase IV.
